text_en: After the plague the Lord said to Moses and to Eleazar son of Aaron the priest,
text_cn: 这次灾祸以后，上主对梅瑟和大司祭亚郎的儿子厄肋阿匝尔说：

text_en: “Take a census of the whole congregation of the Israelites, from twenty years old and upward, by their ancestral houses, everyone in Israel able to go to war. ”
text_cn: “你们应将以色列子民全会众，凡二十岁以上，在以色列中能上阵作战的，按家族再行登记。”

text_en: Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them in the plains of Moab by the Jordan opposite Jericho, saying,
text_cn: 梅瑟和司祭厄肋阿匝尔，就在约但河边耶里哥的对面，摩阿布旷野内，统计了

text_en: “Take a census of the people, from twenty years old and upward, ” as the Lord commanded Moses. The Israelites, who came out of the land of Egypt, were:
text_cn: 二十岁以上的人，照上主对梅瑟所吩咐的。 从埃及国出来的以色列子民如下：

text_en: Reuben, the firstborn of Israel. The descendants of Reuben: of Hanoch, the clan of the Hanochites; of Pallu, the clan of the Palluites;
text_cn: 以色列的长子勒乌本：勒乌本的子孙：属哈诺客人的，有哈诺客家族；属帕路的，有帕路家族；

text_en: of Hezron, the clan of the Hezronites; of Carmi, the clan of the Carmites.
text_cn: 属赫兹龙的，有赫兹龙家族；属加尔米的，有加尔米家族：

text_en: These are the clans of the Reubenites; the number of those enrolled was forty-three thousand seven hundred thirty.
text_cn: 以上是勒乌本家族，登记的人数，共计四万三千七百三十。

text_en: And the descendants of Pallu: Eliab.
text_cn: 帕路的子孙：厄里雅布。

text_en: The descendants of Eliab: Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram. These are the same Dathan and Abiram, chosen from the congregation, who rebelled against Moses and Aaron in the company of Korah, when they rebelled against the Lord ,
text_cn: 厄里雅布的儿子是乃慕耳、达堂和阿彼兰。达堂和阿彼兰原是会众推选的人，在科辣黑党派违背上主时，起来反抗梅瑟和亚郎。

text_en: and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up along with Korah, when that company died, when the fire devoured two hundred fifty men; and they became a warning.
text_cn: 当时地裂开了口，将他们同科辣黑吞了下去；同时有火烧死了二百五十人：这样全党都消灭了，作为后人的鉴戒。

text_en: Notwithstanding, the sons of Korah did not die.
text_cn: 但是科辣黑的儿子们却没有死亡。

text_en: The descendants of Simeon by their clans: of Nemuel, the clan of the Nemuelites; of Jamin, the clan of the Jaminites; of Jachin, the clan of the Jachinites;
text_cn: 西默盎的子孙：按照家族属乃慕耳的，有乃慕耳家族；属雅明的，有雅明家族；属雅津的，有雅津家族；

text_en: of Zerah, the clan of the Zerahites; of Shaul, the clan of the Shaulites.
text_cn: 属则辣黑的，有则辣黑家族；属沙乌耳的，有沙乌耳家族：

text_en: These are the clans of the Simeonites, twenty-two thousand two hundred.
text_cn: 以上是西默盎家族，人数共计二万二千二百。

text_en: The children of Gad by their clans: of Zephon, the clan of the Zephonites; of Haggi, the clan of the Haggites; of Shuni, the clan of the Shunites;
text_cn: 加得的子孙：按照家族，属责丰的，有责丰家族；属哈基的，有哈基家族；属叔尼的，有叔尼家族；

text_en: of Ozni, the clan of the Oznites; of Eri, the clan of the Erites;
text_cn: 属敖次尼的，有敖次尼家族；属厄黎的，有厄黎家族；

text_en: of Arod, the clan of the Arodites; of Areli, the clan of the Arelites.
text_cn: 属阿洛得的，有阿洛得家族；属阿勒里的，有阿勒里家族：

text_en: These are the clans of the Gadites: the number of those enrolled was forty thousand five hundred.
text_cn: 以上是加得子孙的家族，登记的人数共计四万五百。

text_en: The sons of Judah: Er and Onan; Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.
text_cn: 犹大的儿子：厄尔和敖难。厄尔和敖难死在客纳罕地。

text_en: The descendants of Judah by their clans were: of Shelah, the clan of the Shelanites; of Perez, the clan of the Perezites; of Zerah, the clan of the Zerahites.
text_cn: 犹大的子孙：按照家族，属舍拉的，有舍拉家族；属培勒兹的，有培勒兹家族；属则辣黑的，有则辣黑家族。

text_en: The descendants of Perez were: of Hezron, the clan of the Hezronites; of Hamul, the clan of the Hamulites.
text_cn: 培勒兹的子孙：属赫兹龙的，有赫兹龙家族；属哈慕耳的，有哈慕耳家族：

text_en: These are the clans of Judah: the number of those enrolled was seventy-six thousand five hundred.
text_cn: 以上是犹大家族，登记的人数，共计七万六千五百。

text_en: The descendants of Issachar by their clans: of Tola, the clan of the Tolaites; of Puvah, the clan of the Punites;
text_cn: 依撒加尔的子孙：按照家族，属托拉的，有托拉家族；属普瓦的，有普瓦家族；

text_en: of Jashub, the clan of the Jashubites; of Shimron, the clan of the Shimronites.
text_cn: 属雅叔布的，有雅叔布家族；属史默龙的，有史默龙家族：

text_en: These are the clans of Issachar: sixty-four thousand three hundred enrolled.
text_cn: 以上是依撒加尔家族，登记人数共计六万四千三百。

text_en: The descendants of Zebulun by their clans: of Sered, the clan of the Seredites; of Elon, the clan of the Elonites; of Jahleel, the clan of the Jahleelites.
text_cn: 则步隆的子孙：依照家族，属色勒得的，有色勒得家族；属厄隆的，有厄隆家族；属雅赫肋耳的，有雅赫肋耳家族：

text_en: These are the clans of the Zebulunites; the number of those enrolled was sixty thousand five hundred.
text_cn: 以上是则步隆家族，登记的人数共计六万五百。

text_en: The sons of Joseph by their clans: Manasseh and Ephraim.
text_cn: 若瑟的子孙：按照家族，有默纳协族和厄弗辣因族。

text_en: The descendants of Manasseh: of Machir, the clan of the Machirites; and Machir was the father of Gilead; of Gilead, the clan of the Gileadites.
text_cn: 默纳协的子孙：属玛基尔的，有玛基尔家族；玛基尔生了基肋阿得，属基肋阿得的，有基肋阿得家族。

text_en: These are the descendants of Gilead: of Iezer, the clan of the Iezerites; of Helek, the clan of the Helekites;
text_cn: 以下是基肋阿得的子孙：属耶则尔的，有耶则尔家族；属赫肋克的，有赫肋克家族；

text_en: and of Asriel, the clan of the Asrielites; and of Shechem, the clan of the Shechemites;
text_cn: 属阿斯黎耳的，有阿斯黎耳家族；属舍根的，有舍根家族；

text_en: and of Shemida, the clan of the Shemidaites; and of Hepher, the clan of the Hepherites.
text_cn: 属舍米达的，有舍米达家族；属赫斐尔的，有赫斐尔家族。

text_en: Now Zelophehad son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
text_cn: 赫斐尔的儿子责罗斐哈得没有儿子，只有女儿；责罗斐哈得的女儿的名字是：玛赫拉、诺阿、曷革拉、米耳加和提尔匝：

text_en: These are the clans of Manasseh; the number of those enrolled was fifty-two thousand seven hundred.
text_cn: 以上是默纳协家族，登记的人数共计五万二千七百。

text_en: These are the descendants of Ephraim according to their clans: of Shuthelah, the clan of the Shuthelahites; of Becher, the clan of the Becherites; of Tahan, the clan of the Tahanites.
text_cn: 以下是厄弗辣因的子孙：按照家族，属叔特拉的，有叔特拉家族；属贝革尔的，有贝革尔家族；属塔罕的，有塔罕家族。

text_en: And these are the descendants of Shuthelah: of Eran, the clan of the Eranites.
text_cn: 以下是叔特拉的子孙：属厄兰的，有厄兰家族。

text_en: These are the clans of the Ephraimites: the number of those enrolled was thirty-two thousand five hundred. These are the descendants of Joseph by their clans.
text_cn: 以上是厄弗辣因子孙家族，登记的人数共计三万二千五百：以上按照家族，都是若瑟的子孙。

text_en: The descendants of Benjamin by their clans: of Bela, the clan of the Belaites; of Ashbel, the clan of the Ashbelites; of Ahiram, the clan of the Ahiramites;
text_cn: 本雅明的子孙：按照家族，属贝拉的，有贝拉家族；属阿市贝耳的，有阿市贝耳家族；属阿希兰的，有阿希兰家族；

text_en: of Shephupham, the clan of the Shuphamites; of Hupham, the clan of the Huphamites.
text_cn: 属舍孚番的，有舍孚番家族；属胡番的，有胡番家族。

text_en: And the sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: of Ard, the clan of the Ardites; of Naaman, the clan of the Naamites.
text_cn: 贝拉的儿子是阿尔德和纳阿曼。属阿尔德的，有阿尔德家族；属纳阿曼的，有纳阿曼家族：

text_en: These are the descendants of Benjamin by their clans; the number of those enrolled was forty-five thousand six hundred.
text_cn: 按照家族，这些都是本雅明的子孙，登记的人数共计四万五千六百。

text_en: These are the descendants of Dan by their clans: of Shuham, the clan of the Shuhamites. These are the clans of Dan by their clans.
text_cn: 以下是丹的子孙：按照家族，属叔罕的，有叔罕家族：按照家族，这是丹的家族。

text_en: All the clans of the Shuhamites: sixty-four thousand four hundred enrolled.
text_cn: 叔罕全家族登记的人数，共计六万四千四百。

text_en: The descendants of Asher by their families: of Imnah, the clan of the Imnites; of Ishvi, the clan of the Ishvites; of Beriah, the clan of the Beriites.
text_cn: 阿协尔的子孙：按照家族，属依默纳的，有依默纳家族；属依市伟的，有依市伟家族；属贝黎雅的，有贝黎雅家族。

text_en: Of the descendants of Beriah: of Heber, the clan of the Heberites; of Malchiel, the clan of the Malchielites.
text_cn: 贝黎雅的子孙：属赫贝尔的，有赫贝尔家族；属玛耳基耳的，有玛耳基耳家族。

text_en: And the name of the daughter of Asher was Serah.
text_cn: 阿协尔的女儿的名字是色辣黑。

text_en: These are the clans of the Asherites: the number of those enrolled was fifty-three thousand four hundred.
text_cn: 以上是阿协尔子孙的家族，登记的人数共计五万三千四百。

text_en: The descendants of Naphtali by their clans: of Jahzeel, the clan of the Jahzeelites; of Guni, the clan of the Gunites;
text_cn: 纳斐塔里的子孙：按照家族，属雅赫责耳的，有雅赫责耳家族；属古尼的，有古尼家族；

text_en: of Jezer, the clan of the Jezerites; of Shillem, the clan of the Shillemites.
text_cn: 属耶则尔的，有耶则尔家族；属史冷的，有史冷家族：

text_en: These are the Naphtalites by their clans: the number of those enrolled was forty-five thousand four hundred.
text_cn: 按照家族，这些都是纳斐塔里家族，他们登记的人数共计四万五千四百。

text_en: This was the number of the Israelites enrolled: six hundred and one thousand seven hundred thirty.
text_cn: 以色列子民登记的人数，共计六十万一千七百三十。

text_en: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: To these the land shall be apportioned for inheritance according to the number of names.
text_cn: “你应照登记的名额，将土地分配给他们作为产业：

text_en: To a large tribe you shall give a large inheritance, and to a small tribe you shall give a small inheritance; every tribe shall be given its inheritance according to its enrollment.
text_cn: 人数多的应多给，人数少的应少给；各依照登记的名额分配产业。

text_en: But the land shall be apportioned by lot; according to the names of their ancestral tribes they shall inherit.
text_cn: 但还应抽签来分配土地，各按宗族支系的名字领取产业。

text_en: Their inheritance shall be apportioned according to lot between the larger and the smaller.
text_cn: 看人数的多寡，来抽签，给他们分配产业。”

text_en: This is the enrollment of the Levites by their clans: of Gershon, the clan of the Gershonites; of Kohath, the clan of the Kohathites; of Merari, the clan of the Merarites.
text_cn: 以下是依照家族登记的肋未人：属革尔雄的，有革尔雄家族；属刻哈特的，有刻哈特家族；属默辣黎的，有默辣黎家族。

text_en: These are the clans of Levi: the clan of the Libnites, the clan of the Hebronites, the clan of the Mahlites, the clan of the Mushites, the clan of the Korahites. Now Kohath was the father of Amram.
text_cn: 以下是肋未的家族：里贝尼家族，赫贝龙家族，玛赫里家族，慕史家族，科辣黑家族。刻哈特生了阿默兰；

text_en: The name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed daughter of Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt; and she bore to Amram: Aaron, Moses, and their sister Miriam.
text_cn: 阿默兰的妻子名叫约革贝得，是肋未的女儿，她在埃及出生，给阿默兰生了亚郎、梅瑟和他们的姊妹米黎盎。

text_en: To Aaron were born Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
text_cn: 亚郎生了纳达布，阿彼胡、厄肋阿匝尔和依塔玛尔。

text_en: But Nadab and Abihu died when they offered unholy fire before the Lord .
text_cn: 纳达布和阿彼胡在上主面前献了凡火，遭遇了死亡。

text_en: The number of those enrolled was twenty-three thousand, every male one month old and upward; for they were not enrolled among the Israelites because there was no allotment given to them among the Israelites.
text_cn: 凡一月以上的男子，登记的共计二万三千；他们没有登记在以色列子民的数目内，因为在以色列子民中没有分得产业。

text_en: These were those enrolled by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who enrolled the Israelites in the plains of Moab by the Jordan opposite Jericho.
text_cn: 这是梅瑟和司祭厄肋阿匝尔，在约但河边，耶里哥的对面，摩阿布旷野内，所统计的以色列子民的人数。

text_en: Among these there was not one of those enrolled by Moses and Aaron the priest, who had enrolled the Israelites in the wilderness of Sinai.
text_cn: 他们中，没有一个是梅瑟和大司祭亚郎，在西乃旷野统计以色列子民时，所统计过的人，

text_en: For the Lord had said of them, “They shall die in the wilderness. ” Not one of them was left, except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.
text_cn: 因为上主论及他们曾说过，他们必死在旷野。实在，除了耶孚乃的儿子加肋布和农的儿子若苏厄外，他们中没有剩下一人。
